$comment: Import request for HCG Store's Release Manager. The files are imported exactly as HCG Mail's CI built them: nothing is rebuilt, re-packed or re-signed. Every value below must match the draft and the Release Passports, or the import stops. requestedEligibility: the draft itself is private (HCG Mail's CI never asks for publication); this request asks for public eligibility so that, after the owner approves and separately publishes it, the release can be delivered free during a testing window. knownLimitations: from HCG Mail's docs/RELEASE_NOTES_0.1.0-beta.1.md and the run's evidence.
knownLimitations: Not code-signed (no Authenticode signature on the installers or HCGMail.exe): Windows SmartScreen warns on download and first start. Run a file only if its SHA-256 matches the published checksum.

Signing in to a mailbox, sending and receiving (authenticated IMAP/SMTP) have not been tested on Windows yet. Automated checks on Windows covered installation, start-up, window rendering, restart, Windows Credential Manager and TLS certificate validation.
Installation and start-up were verified on GitHub-hosted Windows runners (x64: Windows build 26100; ARM64: Windows 11 build 26200), not yet on testers' own PCs.
Microsoft (Outlook.com, Microsoft 365) and Google (Gmail) sign-in are not set up in this build. Use IMAP/SMTP with an app password where your provider allows it.
No automatic updates: a new version is a new download, and the installer upgrades in place.
